subject: Sensitive conduct case — coordination and safeguards
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: conduct concern — team immediate coordination

Team,

I need a quick triage and an initial plan for a sensitive conduct complaint raised this morning by a contributor on the Acme integration team (reported to Laura). The reporter alleges repeated inappropriate comments and pressure from a peer during a sprint planning session last week. Reporter has requested confidentiality and is worried about retaliation.

Immediate asks:
- Can HR confirm whether this needs an urgent safety step (no-contact/interim reassignment) before intake?
- If yes, I need language we can send to the manager and the reporter this afternoon that preserves confidentiality.
- Please preserve Slack and calendar records for both parties and avoid broad distribution of details.

I will add legal if we need redaction or to support evidence handling. Marking as high priority — want an intake meeting by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
People Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Katie Harrison <katie.harrison@legalpartners.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conduct concern — team immediate coordination

Irene — thanks for flagging.

Planned intake steps (proposed):
1) Preserve evidence: I asked IT to snapshot the reporter's Slack thread and both party calendars.
2) Interim protections (recommended): no-contact directive and temporary reassignment of the reporter to avoid daily overlap with the other contributor; manager to be told only necessary facts.
3) Intake meeting: schedule 30m with reporter + HR investigator (Monica) tomorrow 10:00 AM PT.
4) Notify legal (cc'd) for redaction and any data retention steps.

Attached: prelim_timeline.pdf — my assembled timestamps from the reporter's account (redacted for now).

If we agree, I'll send the manager outreach and the reporter's confidentiality note. Laura — confirm you can do the reassignment logistics once we sign off.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference

Attachments: prelim_timeline.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Katie Harrison <katie.harrison@legalpartners.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-16T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conduct concern — team immediate coordination

Monica / Irene — thanks for the heads up. A couple of legal notes:
- Limit distribution of the timeline to HR + legal + the direct manager on a need-to-know basis.
- When you share the manager outreach, include a line asking them not to discuss specifics with other team members and to escalate any pushback to HR.
- For preservation: use the secure evidence folder and avoid sending the raw Slack export over email. I attached a short redaction_guidance.docx that shows what to remove for any wider distribution.

I'll be available for the intake call if you want counsel present for privilege.

Best,
Katie Harrison
Senior Counsel | LegalPartners

Attachments: redaction_guidance.docx (DOCX, 2 pages)
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-17T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: conduct concern — team immediate coordination

Monica — I confirm I can implement the interim measures.

Action I'll take after your go-ahead:
- Reassign the reporter to the API reliability squad for the next two weeks (no overlap with the other contributor).
- Send the manager note (using HR language) asking them to limit discussion to the individuals copied and to escalate any queries.
- Reinforce no-contact expectations with the contributor in question; I'll separate collaboration channels and remove them from the shared sprint planning invite.

Please send me the exact text you want me to use. I will not share details beyond this chain.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Engineering Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference

Thanks all for the quick turnaround and thoughtful handling. Summarizing agreed next steps and owners so we have one source of truth: 

1) Evidence preservation — Monica/IT (owner: Monica). IT snapshot stored in secure evidence folder (link below). Do not copy to email.
2) Interim protections — Laura will reassign reporter to API reliability squad (owner: Laura). No-contact directive in place until formal intake is complete (HR to provide language).
3) Intake meeting — Monica + reporter tomorrow 10:00 AM PT; Katie available to join for counsel.
4) Manager outreach — Monica to send targeted manager note using Katie's guidance on limited distribution.
5) Confidentiality & non-retaliation — Rishi to prepare a short reminder communication to managers this week; tone must reiterate non-retaliation and reporting channels.

I will send a brief confidentiality reminder to the Integrations leadership and ask that they do not discuss specifics. Please do not forward any attachments outside of the HR/legal group.

Drive folder (evidence & redacted docs): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example-case-folder

If anything changes before the intake call, ping me directly. Thank you for keeping this tight.

Irene
